problem: The platform felt frozen: pages show skeletons for 7-10 s
evidence: POST /api/progress measured 6.6-7.8 s x6 on production; 3 of 8 parallel requests to /api/me (no DB) took 7.7-12.3 s
root_cause: listPlayable() queried the remote DB once per case (30 sequential queries, full JSON each)
proposed_fix: getPlayableMany/getCardsLight: 2 light queries; warm requests 0.14-0.7 s

problem: First request on every new serverless instance took 8-10 s
evidence: /api/me 8.2-10.6 s on 8/8 cold instances; instrumentation.ts awaits migrate()+syncFileCases() (about 60 remote round trips)
root_cause: syncFileCases ran SELECT+hash+UPDATE per case, uploading full JSON; production is in preview mode so all 30 cases are drafts
proposed_fix: one listing query; write only rows that differ

problem: Every production deploy failed (ERROR) so no SEO/perf work reached users
evidence: Vercel events: 'chunking context does not support external modules (request: node:fs)' on /labs/page
root_cause: client component LabsClient imported KIND_LABEL from engine/labs.ts (node:fs)

problem: Horizontal scroll: page 444 px wide on a 390 px screen
evidence: scan_dom horizontal_overflow=true; element: span.badge 'قوة الدليل البحثي: …' spans left=-54px,right=355px
root_cause: `.badge` is white-space:nowrap and the text is long
status: fixed in code (737a05a); verify in after pass

problem: Page is 62,487 px tall with ~220 full cards mounted at once
evidence: page_height=62487, content_chars=44328, 1708 interactive targets <32 px on mobile

acceptance_test: height drops; #GL-id deep link still scrolls to item
status: fixed in code (7b8d31e); verify in after pass

status: fixed in code; verify in after pass

problem: Skeleton cards only for several seconds
